goal.insight: Encode 7 parallel axes (GDP per capita, HDI, Freedom Index, Corruption Perceptions Index, CO2 emissions per capita, Military expenditure % GDP, Internet penetration %), with each polyline representing a country colored by World Bank income group (high/upper-middle/lower-middle/low)
Show how the four income-group color bands separate or overlap across the seven dimensions, emphasizing where high-income and low-income polylines diverge most strongly versus where they intermingle

Highlight crossing patterns between adjacent axes — particularly where countries that rank high on one dimension drop sharply on the next — to reveal nonlinear relationships among development indicators

Visually emphasize countries whose polyline profiles deviate dramatically from their income-group peers, such as high-income nations with unusually high carbon emissions or upper-middle-income nations with low freedom scores

Draw attention to the visual clustering pattern between the Freedom Index and Corruption Perceptions Index axes, showing whether polylines remain relatively parallel or diverge between these two dimensions
